name.value: University of British Columbia Okanagan Library

description.value: The UBC Okanagan Library is the central academic library on the UBC Okanagan campus, situated on the territory of the Syilx Okanagan Nation in Kelowna. It serves students, faculty, staff, and community visitors, offering a wide range of study and collaboration spaces, special collections, and an Inclusive Technology Lab. Community members and visitors are explicitly welcomed, making it a potential rest stop for touring cyclists passing through the UBCO campus.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: lockers (covered, secure) at 45m; wall_loops (covered) at 50m.
